description: This file contains the class 'ReturnAction' which defines methods for managing 'Return Action' entities within the OpenCart system. It provides functionality to add, edit, delete, and fetch return actions, including their descriptions and associated metadata.

classes.name: ReturnAction
classes.description: Model class responsible for CRUD operations and data retrieval related to return actions in the localisation module of OpenCart.

methods.name: addReturnAction
methods.description: Adds a new return action along with its descriptions for different languages. Returns the ID of the newly created return action.

methods.name: editReturnAction
methods.description: Updates an existing return action and its descriptions based on the return action ID.

methods.name: deleteReturnReturnAction
methods.description: Deletes a return action identified by its ID.

methods.name: getReturnAction
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific return action, including its description for the current system language.

methods.name: getReturnActions
methods.description: Fetches a list of return actions, optionally sorted and paginated based on input parameters.

methods.name: getTotalReturnActions
methods.description: Returns the total count of return actions in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a return action in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions of a return action across all supported languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions of return actions filtered by a specific language ID.

methods.name: deleteReturnActionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return action descriptions associated with a particular language ID.
